Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018
AUDITED FINANCIAL RESULTS FOR THE FOURTH QUARTER AND YEAR ENDED 31.03.2026

analysis.summary: Sri Ramakrishna Mills (Coimbatore) Limited reported total turnover of Rs. 8,725.93 lakhs for the financial year ended March 31, 2025, compared to Rs. 5,967.13 lakhs in the previous year, which includes real estate income of Rs. 1,099.20 lakhs. The company recorded a net profit of Rs.

demand_outlook.claim: The Indian textile industry experienced challenges in FY25 due to global trade uncertainties and price fluctuations despite domestic demand showing signs of recovery.
demand_outlook.quote: In FY25, the Indian Textile Industry experienced challenges.

demand_outlook.claim: Market trends indicate stable demand conditions.
demand_outlook.quote: Market trends indicate stable demand conditions.

demand_outlook.claim: Cotton yarn mills have seen traction in domestic demand amidst slower exports.
demand_outlook.quote: Amidst slower exports, cotton yarn mills have seen traction in domestic demand with newer trade policies the exports will grow due to higher tariffs on other countries.

demand_outlook.claim: Yarn demand is likely to gain traction from healthy domestic demand prospects and strong off-take from downstream segments like apparels in FY2026.
demand_outlook.quote: The industry is likely to further shift gears in FY2026, with yarn demand likely to gain traction from the healthy prospects in domestic demand, especially with strong off-take from downstream segments like apparels.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that adverse economic conditions in importing countries and the Red Sea crisis are impacting textile exports.
demand_outlook.quote: Adverse economic conditions prevailing in major importing Countries, coupled with the Red Sea crisis are impacting the export of Indian textile products.

demand_outlook.claim: The global cotton yarn market has grown strongly in recent years driven by textile industry growth and preference for natural fibers.
demand_outlook.quote: The Global cotton yarn market size has grown strongly in recent years due to the growth of the textile industry, the preference for natural fibers, trends in global cotton production, innovations in cotton yarn, and the increased affordability and accessibility of textile materials.

demand_outlook.claim: The year under review witnessed lower margins driven by a drop in yarn prices from cotton price fluctuations and lesser demand.
demand_outlook.quote: However the year under review has witnessed an unprecedented lower margin due to drop in yarn prices on account of fluctuation in cotton prices and lesser demand.

demand_outlook.claim: Factors contributing to the outlook include cotton price fluctuations, lower yarn realizations, reduced downstream apparel demand, and rising energy costs.
demand_outlook.quote: The fluctuation in cotton prices, lower yarn price realization; reduced demand from downstream apparel companies; increase in energy cost are some of the contributing factors.

demand_outlook.claim: Management expects textile exports to improve in the coming months as the US market shows signs of revival.
demand_outlook.quote: With the US market showing signs of revival, we expect the textile exports to improve in the coming months.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the overall demand is expected to remain low.
demand_outlook.quote: The Company expects the overall demand to remain low.

demand_outlook.claim: The company noted that the coming year will present challenges regarding pricing.
demand_outlook.quote: Coming year will be challenging with respect to pricing.

demand_outlook.claim: Management highlighted that unless textile exports increase significantly, the entire sector will continue to operate below capacity.
demand_outlook.quote: Unless textile exports pick up substantially, the whole sector will work below capacities.

capex_expansion.claim: The real estate project is completed and all villas and apartments have been sold.
capex_expansion.quote: Our project is completed and sold all villas and apartments have been sold.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is replacing old machinery in the Nagari unit with modernized machinery in a phased manner.
capex_expansion.quote: Our company is replacing its old machineries used in Nagari unit with all modernized machineries in a phased manner.

capex_expansion.claim: Management stated that the entire modernization will be completed within the year.
capex_expansion.quote: The entire moderinazation will be completed within this year.

capex_expansion.claim: The real estate project is expected to be completed by September 2023.
capex_expansion.quote: Our project is expected to be completed by September 2023 and we expect to sell the remaining villas within a year.

margins_costs.claim: Surging power costs have negatively impacted profit margins.
margins_costs.quote: The surge in the power cost has also impacted the margin.

margins_costs.claim: Management pointed out that costlier cotton is a major pain point for the Indian garment industry.
margins_costs.quote: Costlier cotton is the key pain point for the Indian garment industry.

margins_costs.claim: The company observed that cotton yarn prices did not increase in line with cotton prices.
margins_costs.quote: Cotton yarn price was not in tune with rise in cotton prices.

margins_costs.claim: Management noted that wild fluctuations in cotton prices have impacted the margins of the industry as a whole.
margins_costs.quote: The wild fluctuation in its prices - highest ever has impacted the margins of the Industry as a whole.

orders_capacity.claim: Downstream activity and garmenting are operating at reduced capacity.
orders_capacity.quote: Downstream activity of working and garmenting is working at reduced capacity and so spinning sector is working at reduced capacity with yarn exports also down by 30% putting a lot of pressure on yarn prices.

capital_allocation.claim: The company has not accepted any deposits within the meaning of Section 73 of the Act.
capital_allocation.quote: The Company has not accepted any deposits within the meaning of Section 73 of the Act, and the Rules framed thereunder.

capital_allocation.claim: The company approached Axis Bank for a loan and replaced The South Indian Bank as its banker after closing all accounts with SIB.
capital_allocation.quote: Our company has approached Axis Bank for loan and now our bankers are Axis Bank instead of The South Indian Bank.

risks_headwinds.claim: Trade challenges persist due to weak global demand.
risks_headwinds.quote: Though supported by strong domestic demand, narrowing trade deficit and controlled inflation, the trade challenges persist due to weak global demand.

risks_headwinds.claim: Yarn exports are down by 30%, which places pressure on yarn prices.
risks_headwinds.quote: with yarn exports also down by 30% putting a lot of pressure on yarn prices.

risks_headwinds.claim: An 11% duty on cotton imports keeps local prices firm despite a drop in international cotton prices.
risks_headwinds.quote: Cotton prices have come down but still above last year prices and with 11% duty on cotton imports, local prices are firm.

management_commitments.claim: Sri. P. Muthusamy is re-appointed as Director - Operations for a period of three years with effect from 27.09.2025.
management_commitments.quote: Sri.P.Muthusamy (DIN : 02651331) be and is hereby re- appointed as Director – Operations for a period of three years with effect from 27.09.2025 with remuneration on the terms and conditions including as to remuneration set out in the draft agreement submitted to this meeting and initialed by Chairman of the meeting for the purpose of identification.

management_commitments.claim: The company proposed to replace existing motors with energy-efficient motors attached to various machinery.
management_commitments.quote: Proposed to replace the existing motors with energy efficient motors attached to various machinery.

management_commitments.claim: The entire modernization of the Nagari unit will be completed within the year.
management_commitments.quote: The entire moderinazation will be completed within this year.

management_commitments.claim: The real estate project is expected to be completed by September 2023.
management_commitments.quote: Our project is expected to be completed by September 2023 and we expect to sell the remaining villas within a year.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
